machineScope.reason: Durable no-replace records belong to the local installation setup. Threadline uses this writer for public identity and encrypted staging; staging reclamation is declared beside threadline-runtime.mjs. Identity derives from the installation storage key and enters existing custody. Private routes are owner-signed machine-local filesystem paths; moving a route needs an updated signed binding, never a new identity or automatic resend. Authoritative transport data stays in the existing encrypted journal and follows its replication demand.
